name: Researchers Fully Map Neural Connections of the Fruit Fly Brain
snippet: Oct 2, 2024 — The map provides a wiring diagram, known as a connectome , and is the largest and most complete connectome of an adult animal ever created.

name: Connectomes: Mapping the mind of a fly
snippet: by J Pipkin · 2020 · Cited by 8 — Scientists have created the most detailed map of the fruit fly brain to date, identifying over 25,000 neurons and 20 million synapses. Read more
